response: chat with repository evidence and reproducible notebook
scope: all saved valid priced FT observations, including outside Top5; no production rule changes
fold_assignment: first available valid priced point per event; every point of one event in one fold
delay_rule: first qualifying trigger; first available later point after delay, same score and all conditions rechecked; no best-point hindsight
descriptive_stability: ROI and ROI without top3 positive in every fold; positive excluding best day overall; >=2 positive test days with >=10 results each
statistical_confirmation: positive late ROI with multiplicity-adjusted one-sided p <=0.05 and positive game bootstrap 95% lower bound; day-cluster bootstrap also reported
multiplicity: all evaluated rules across both sides counted; exact duplicate event/entry selections deduplicated for the statistical family
repeated_history_warning: 24-25 October was already inspected in previous audits; temporal checks here are retrospective, not independent future confirmation
settlement: flat unit, actual side quote, quarter Asian legs and pushes; missing/conflicting final excluded and coverage reported
availability: only fields known by entry decision time; later cached prices cannot backfill earlier points; histories never treated as simultaneous alternative quotes
league_identity: provider ID where available, unique verified event/name mappings, unresolved name groups kept separate
score_corrections: Chronology features are unknown if any observed score component decreased before entry; a drought requires all intervening saved scores to be unchanged.
quality_amendment: After the initial exploratory scan, an observed-score rollback guard was added and the entire feature/search/validation pipeline rerun. This amendment does not create a new independent test.
